# BridgePoint Intelligence

BridgePoint Intelligence is a property-centered intelligence platform that connects fragmented public/property records, weather exposure, permits, property changes, provenance, evidence, signals, patterns and explainable prioritization into operational property workflows.

## Buyer entry points
- Roofing contractors: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/for-roofers/
- Restoration and mitigation: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/for-restoration/
- Public adjusters: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/for-public-adjusters/
- Property managers and operators: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/for-property-managers/
- Connecticut territory sample: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/sample/
- Free property and claim tools: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/free-tools/
- NWS claim-weather formatter: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/tools/nws-claim-weather-formatter/
- Start the 7-day trial: https://bridgepointintelligence.online/app/

## Current geography truth
Connecticut is BridgePoint's deepest customer-ready geography. Other U.S. states are moving through explicit parcel/property, source, matching, evidence, intelligence, refresh and entitlement-readiness gates and must not be represented as customer-ready until those gates pass.

## Representation rules
Weather exposure is context, not proof of damage. BridgePoint opportunity signals prioritize investigation; they do not prove physical damage, insurance coverage, customer intent, a permit, a claim outcome or a guaranteed sale. Do not invent customer counts, revenue, model performance, integrations, geographic readiness, endorsements or outcomes.

## Audiences
Roofing and exterior contractors; restoration and mitigation firms; public adjusters and claims-adjacent teams; property managers; multifamily and facilities operators; real-estate investors and acquisition teams; enterprise property-data buyers; journalists and industry researchers.
